item.title: Juneau School Board selects three finalists for new superintendent
item.description: Two candidates are already based in Juneau, and all three have experience with education in Alaska.

item.title: Survey says streets, schools and safety among Juneau’s top priorities ahead of looming city cuts
item.description: The Juneau Assembly will use the results to figure out how to mend the estimated $10 to $12 million recurring hole in the city’s budget resulting from last fall's ballot initiatives.

item.title: Major oil tax rewrite headlines new Alaska Senate draft of Dunleavy tax bill
item.description: The new version strips out an unpopular sales tax and substantially rewrites the state's oil and gas tax code to extract more revenue from the industry.

item.title: Alaska lawmakers probe state detention policies following ICE arrest of Soldotna family
item.description: Clergy, immigration attorneys and advocates raised concerns about increased ICE operations in Alaska, particularly the detention of minors.

item.title: Indigenous language educators work to establish Master’s teaching program at University of Alaska Southeast
item.description: Language educators in Juneau are working to create a Master’s in Teaching program for Indigenous languages at the University of Alaska Southeast. It would be the first of its kind in Alaska.

item.title: Juneau planning commission approves permit for $60M theater project in downtown tourism corridor
item.description: The project would sit on a 1-acre empty lot next to the downtown library and parking garage and includes three large interactive theaters/rides, a retail store and some office space.

item.title: Man previously staying at Glory Hall shelter reported missing
item.description: A Juneau man who had been staying at a local shelter for unhoused people has not been seen by staff in more than two weeks and has been reported missing.

item.title: Theatre in the Rough’s ‘Weekend of Revolution,’ Juneau String Ensembles’ Chamber Music Night, and Becca Parks from the Juneau Chamber
item.description: Juneau Afternoon featuring Juneau String Ensembles: "Chamber Music Night," Theatre in the Rough's "Weekend of Revolution," and Becca Parks from the Juneau Chamber of Commerce.
